softphone.bridge/authored/a-refusal-leav.purpose: A refused ConfirmBridge leaves the bridge in the store, still Closed.

softphone.bridge/authored/adversary-a-re.purpose: A refused second CloseBridge leaves the closed bridge in the store, still Closed.
A refused ConfirmBridge does not record the answer it refused.

softphone.bridge/authored/bridge-carries.purpose: A media session over the bridge binding carries a dialled call, answered, then hung up.

softphone.bridge/authored/bridge-lost-mi.purpose: A live call loses its bridge; the session is terminated and the call fails on media.

softphone.bridge/authored/refusals-on-a-.purpose: A closed bridge refuses the answer, a second close and a failure, and publishes nothing.

softphone.control/authored/a-refusal-lea.purpose: A refused Answer leaves the ended call in the store, still Ended.

softphone.control/authored/dtmf-and-mute.purpose: On an established call the user sends digits to an IVR and mutes themselves.

softphone.control/authored/inbound-call-.purpose: A call arrives, rings, the user answers it, and media connects.
The user declines a ringing call with 486 Busy Here.
A call arrives, rings, and the caller gives up before it is answered.

softphone.control/authored/media-fails-a.purpose: The user answers, media never connects, and the call ends without ever being Active.

softphone.control/authored/outbound-call.purpose: A dialled call rings, the far end answers, media connects, and the user hangs up.

softphone.control/authored/refusals-on-a.purpose: Every command that declares a wrong-state branch refuses an ended call and publishes nothing.

softphone.directory/authored/adversary-a.purpose: ContactAddresses answers one contact's live address, not the store's.

softphone.directory/authored/phonebook-c.purpose: A contact is added with two addresses, one is removed, and the contact is deleted.

softphone.media/authored/adversary-a-ref.purpose: A refused second activation leaves the live session's profile as it was opened.
A refused second TerminateSession leaves the terminated session in the store.

softphone.media/authored/media-session-l.purpose: A media session is opened, goes live, carries a DTMF digit, and is terminated.

softphone.media/authored/refusals-on-a-r.purpose: A session already Live refuses a second activation, and a terminated one a second termination.

softphone.presence/authored/presence-ann.purpose: A phone announces itself, is confirmed, sees two other phones, and one of them departs.

softphone.presence/authored/refusals-on-.purpose: A withdrawn presence cannot be confirmed and a departed phone cannot depart again.

softphone.sip/authored/registration-reco.purpose: A registration fails, is retried, succeeds, and is later given up deliberately.
